name: Open With
description: 输入框左侧一颗按钮：主区点击用当前选中的应用打开当前工作目录（在 ▾ 列表里点选即全局切换——点选仅切换不打开，打开只属于主按钮；选中持久保存）；▾ 打开应用管理弹层，可添加、编辑、删除自定义打开方式——粘贴 exe 完整路径（校验 .exe 结尾与文件存在，自动清洗隐形字符），保存时提取该 exe 的图标显示在列表与按钮上。资源管理器为内置默认，任何机器都有且不可编辑、不可删除。
author: Eureka-0x01
changelog: 0.1.0：首次正式发布。通过输入框底栏按钮使用选中的应用打开当前项目目录；支持添加、编辑和删除自定义打开方式，保存选中状态，删除选中应用后回落内置文件管理器；支持 Windows exe 路径清理、校验和程序图标提取。
safetyNotes: 在宿主主窗口中显示按钮和弹层；读取当前项目目录，将其作为参数传给系统文件管理器或用户保存的程序。应用路径、参数、选中状态和图标存于插件设置。Windows 上检查盘符绝对路径是否存在，并调用系统 PowerShell 提取程序图标。不联网、不读取剪贴板，不主动修改或删除项目文件。外部程序按其自身权限运行。

en.name: Open With
en.description: One button in the composer bar: the main part opens the current workspace folder with the currently selected app (click an app in the chevron list to switch globally; the choice persists); the chevron opens an app-picker menu where custom launchers can be added, edited and removed — paste the full .exe path (validated for the .exe extension and file existence, with invisible-character cleanup); the launcher's exe icon is extracted on save and shown in the list and on the button. The file manager is the built-in default — present on every machine, locked and not editable.
en.safetyNotes: Renders a button and layers inside the host window. Reads the current workspace path and passes it to the system file manager or a user-configured executable. Launcher paths, arguments, selection and icons are stored in plugin settings. On Windows, drive-letter absolute paths are checked for existence and system PowerShell is used to extract executable icons. No network or clipboard access; the plugin does not intentionally modify or delete project files. Launched applications run with their own permissions.
